hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook for the pmav.fun V2 platform (Robinhood Chain) using a quote ERC20 (USDG). Manages a constant-product AMM curve from token launch to graduation: enforces block+1 trading delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap refund waterfall, decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, 1% quote-denominated fees, and in-place graduation to a full-range V4 pool with dynamic LP fee.
